description: This file defines the ConnectorsController class which manages connector-related actions in the SuiteCRM platform. It handles operations such as processing connector settings, retrieving source details, managing search forms, executing connector functions, handling SOAP/REST interactions, updating connector metadata and mappings, and managing social fields.

classes.name: ConnectorsController
classes.description: Controller class handling various connector operations such as configuration, data retrieval, testing, mapping, and UI modifications within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method to process incoming requests and route to appropriate actions.

methods.name: action_SetSearch
methods.description: Sets search parameters in session based on user input, associated with specified source and module.

methods.name: action_RetrieveSourceDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a source record, returning HTML formatted string with details.

methods.name: action_GetSearchForm
methods.description: Returns a search form for a specific source and module in AJAX mode.

methods.name: action_CallConnectorFunc
methods.description: Calls a specified method on a source object dynamically, returning the result in JSON.

methods.name: remoteFileExists
methods.description: Checks if a remote URL exists by performing a curl request.

methods.name: action_CallRest
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to invoke REST endpoints on sources.

methods.name: action_CallSoap
methods.description: Performs a SOAP call to a source and returns selected fields in JSON.

methods.name: action_DefaultSoapPopup
methods.description: Retrieves data via SOAP and displays it in a popup based on a bean record.

methods.name: action_SaveModifyProperties
methods.description: Saves connector source properties and updates configuration files.

methods.name: action_SaveModifyDisplay
methods.description: Updates display configuration for connectors, including metadata and searchdefs.

methods.name: action_SaveModifyMapping
methods.description: Saves mapping configurations for connector sources and updates related files.

methods.name: action_RunTest
methods.description: Tests connector source configuration, outputs success or failure message.

methods.name: action_RetrieveSources
methods.description: Returns a JSON list of configured connector sources.

methods.name: add_social_field
methods.description: Adds a social media-related custom field to a module, including UI panels.

methods.name: create_panel_on_view
methods.description: Creates or updates a panel layout on a given view in SuiteCRM using the ParserFactory.
